title: Victoria Hospital Maternity Block

buildingCutout.basis: Named native Victoria Flats footprint at 17 Barker Road.

terrainReference.basis: Original Hong Kong Principal Datum reading just outside the north downhill entrance arcade.

mapIdentity.provider: Named native OpenStreetMap Victoria Flats footprint and Barker Road service approach, identified as the surveyed maternity block in the official heritage appraisal.
mapIdentity.scope: The named Victoria Flats map outline fixes the width, depth and orientation. The original Lands Department elevations establish the downhill front approach and the much higher rear slope. The Antiquities Advisory Board identifies this structure as the surviving maternity block at 17 Barker Road.

note: The site’s historic appraisal records the arcaded imitation masonry ground storey, two red brick upper storeys, Venetian window, moulded cornice, pitched gabled roof and plain rear. Lookchard’s Qualla original shows the opening proportions, window grids and finishes.
